Sager vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 50719 of 2021
Applicant :- Sager

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Bir Singh,Prem Narayan Tiwari,Sanjiv Kumar Dwivedi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Heard Sri Sanjiv Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pradeep Kumar,
learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 64 of 2021, under Sections 323, 376, 506 IPC, Police Station Modi Nagar, District Ghaziabad during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant under Sections 323, 376 IPC by mother of applicant and according to the FIR applicant committed rape with her mother.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and on the advise of her well wisher a false FIR of rape was lodged against the applicant by his mother only due to the reason that applicant is heavily drunker and in spite of repeated request made by informant he could not change himself.

He further submits that although informant i.e. mother of the applicant in the FIR and in the statement recorded during investigation Sager vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56412661/
1 made allegation of rape against the applicant but when she appeared before the trial court then she turned hostile and did not support the prosecution case.

entities.text: Sager vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that applicant is in jail since January, 2021 i.e. for more than two and half years.

5. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape with her mother and no good reason brought on record on the basis of which it can be said that informant i.e. mother falsely implicated him.

He next submits that although from the record it reflects that mother i.e. prosecutrix of the case has turned hostile but considering the nature of allegation, applicant should not be released on bail.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
7.

Although, from the record it appears that mother of the applicant i.e. victim of the case has turned hostile during trial and applicant is in jail for almost two and half years but allegation against the applicant are serious in nature and his mother herself made allegation of rape against the applicant in the FIR and in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C,
therefore, considering the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

9. However, considering the fact that informant i.e. mother of the applicant has declared hostile,
therefore, trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of eight months from the date of production of certified copy of this order strictly as per provision of Section 309 Cr.P.C. without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, if there is no legal impediment.
10.

It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 AK Pandey  Sager vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56412661/
